description: The worked substitution fixes every variable whose index differs from \(0,2,3\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.worked_identity_outside.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (g : L.Functions 1)
  (a : L.Functions 0) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 2 ∧ x ≠ 3) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.workedAnswer g a x = FirstOrder.Language.var x
